rows.grounds: compound indicating direction or position of the hand; taken as pūrva-dakṣiṇa
fused form hastas + tu; sandhi noted but token kept whole
compound vakra-daṇḍa-yuj describing what the hand holds

items.question: What attributes characterize the front-right hand of this described form?
premises: The subject is the front-right hand.
That hand is adorned with a bracelet.
That hand bears a curved staff.
items.inference: The front-right hand is characterized by wearing a bracelet and holding a curved staff.
uncertainties: Whether pūrvadakṣiṇa qualifies the hand as front-right or east-south in this iconographic context.
items.plain_english: The front-right hand is adorned with a bracelet and holds a curved staff.
